summary: Examples of the fileglob lookup listing .txt files and with_fileglob copying matching files to a destination.
questions: How do I copy every file in a directory with a pattern?

answer_card.title: fileglob lookup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug: msg={{ lookup('ansible.builtin.fileglob', '/my/path/*.txt') }}

- ansible.builtin.copy:
    src: "{{ item }}"
    dest: "/etc/fooapp/"
    owner: "root"
    mode: 0600
  with_fileglob:
    - "/playbooks/files/fooapp/*"
```
